text: Algorithm 1 SAGMM Framework (Training Phase) Input: Graph (X,A) with labels Y , expert pool e=\{e_{1},\dots,e_{N_{0}}\} , pruning threshold \eta , pruning interval t . Output: Updated expert pool e^{\prime} , gating weights G . 1: Initialize: \forall\,e_{i}\in e,\ I(e_{i})=0 . 2: Divide (X,A) and Y into mini-batches \{(X_{b},A_{b}),\,Y_{b}\} . 3: for each batch \bigl(X_{b},A_{b},Y_{b}\bigr) at epoch q do 4: X_{b}^{\prime}\leftarrow(X_{b},A_{b}) Using Eq. ( 5 ). 5: Obtain M , k_{u} , G , and via Eqs. ( 10 ), ( 12 ), ( 13 ), . 6: Determine active experts: S\leftarrow\bigcup_{u}\{\,j\,\mid\,M_{u,j}>0\} . 7: for each expert e_{j}\in S do 8: Compute expert output H_{e_{j}}\leftarrow e_{j}\bigl(X_{b},A_{b}\bigr) . 9: end for 10: Aggregate expert outputs: \bar{Y}_{b}\leftarrow\sum_{j=1}^{N}G_{e_{j}}\,\mathrm{MLP}(H_{e_{j}}) . 11: Evaluate loss \mathcal{L}\leftarrow\mathcal{L}\bigl(Y_{b},\bar{Y}_{b}\bigr) and update weights for e_{j}\in S . 12: Update expert importance I_{t}(e_{i}) via Eq. ( 14 ). 13: if (q\bmod t)==0 then 14: Prune experts using threshold \eta : e\leftarrow\{e_{i}\mid I(e_{i})\geq\eta\} . 15: end if 16: end for 17: return Updated expert pool e^{\prime} and gating weights G .
